supersedes: v1.0 was aborted and retained before summary generation: cold public prompts recorded zero Paged route entries because request-scoped route state was coupled to a one-shot cache-action decision. v1.1 follows the lifecycle and mixed-prefill/decode fix, and requires every generated decode input after the first sampled token to be accounted for by the Paged route.
arm_order: balanced seeded Direct/Paged process order inside matched process blocks

replay.arrival_transform: Within each official contiguous trace window, divide every offset by the window span and multiply by 1.5 seconds. This preserves order and relative gaps but intentionally changes absolute rate.

quality.metric: official LongBench English QA token F1, maximum over reference answers

statistics.effect: 100 * (Paged-hybrid completed requests per second / Direct completed requests per second - 1)

claim_boundary: Passing supports functional equivalence and a 10% throughput/15% P95 operational noninferiority envelope for the forced production contiguous-layout Paged route across the full generated decode lifecycle on this model, GPU, two transformed public traces and six supported LongBench QA cases. It does not show custom fragmented-page K4 superiority, does not reproduce the public traces' absolute arrival rates or joint content-arrival distribution, and is not a full LongBench or LongBench-E leaderboard result.
